trinidad-cuba--trinidad.description: Created in 1969 and long kept for gifts to foreign diplomats, Trinidad went on general sale in 1998 in small quantities. Once rolled at El Laguito, it is now made in Pinar del Río from Vuelta Abajo filler and binder, and the range has grown from the long Fundadores to Reyes, Esmeralda and Topes. Medium in strength, it is floral and earthy, with dried fruit and wood.

thirds.notes: Floral notes with dried apricot and cherry over earth and wood, on a creamy, textured smoke.
Earth grows to match the florals, the fruit holds, and the spice turns peppery on the finish.
Mostly earthy and slightly salty now, with pepper, cocoa and coffee and a pecan note on the retrohale.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Trinidad (Cuba) Fundadores review

trinidad-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Trinidad's Ediciones Limitadas follow the Habanos pattern of sizes outside the regular range, made from leaf aged at least two years under a darker wrapper taken from the top of the shaded plant. The Topes of 2016, 56 x 125 mm in a box of 12 and medium in strength, moved into the regular range in 2019.
